items.text:
अतः परं गृहस्थस्य कर्माचारं कलौ युगे ।
धर्मं साधारणं शक्त्या चातुर्वर्ण्याश्रमागतं ॥ १ ॥
items.tr:
ataḥ paraṃ gṛhasthasya karmācāraṃ kalau yuge |
dharmaṃ sādhāraṇaṃ śaktyā cāturvarṇyāśramāgataṃ || 1 ||
items.en: Next, (I will explain) the duties and conduct of the householder in the Kali age: the common dharma, according to one's ability, for the four varṇas and the stages of life.

items.text:
तं प्रवक्ष्याम्यहं पूर्वं पराशरवचो यथा ।
षट्कर्मसहितो विप्रः कृषिकर्म च कारयेत् ॥ २ ॥
items.tr:
taṃ pravakṣyāmyahaṃ pūrvaṃ parāśaravaco yathā |
ṣaṭkarmasahito vipraḥ kṛṣikarma ca kārayet || 2 ||
items.en: I will explain it first, as Parāśara's words say. A brāhmaṇa who keeps up the six duties may also have farming done.

items.text:
क्षुधितं तृषितं श्रान्तं बलीवर्दं न योजयेत् ।
हीनाङ्गं व्याधितं क्लीबं वृषं विप्रो न वाहयेत् ॥ ३ ॥
items.tr:
kṣudhitaṃ tṛṣitaṃ śrāntaṃ balīvardaṃ na yojayet |
hīnāṅgaṃ vyādhitaṃ klībaṃ vṛṣaṃ vipro na vāhayet || 3 ||
items.en: He should not yoke an ox that is hungry, thirsty or tired. A brāhmaṇa should not drive a bull that is missing a limb, sick or impotent.

items.text:
स्थिराङ्गं नीरुजं तृप्तं सुनर्दं षण्ढवर्जितम् ।
वाहयेद्दिवसस्यार्धं पश्चात्स्नानं समाचरेत् ॥ ४ ॥
items.tr:
sthirāṅgaṃ nīrujaṃ tṛptaṃ sunardaṃ ṣaṇḍhavarjitam |
vāhayeddivasasyārdhaṃ paścātsnānaṃ samācaret || 4 ||
items.en: He should drive one that is sound of limb, healthy, well fed, strong-voiced and not castrated, for half the day, and then bathe.

items.text:
जप्यं देवार्चनं होमं स्वाध्यायं चैवं अभ्यसेत् ।
एकद्वित्रिचतुर्विप्रान्भोजयेत्स्नातकान्द्विजः ॥ ५ ॥
items.tr:
japyaṃ devārcanaṃ homaṃ svādhyāyaṃ caivaṃ abhyaset |
ekadvitricaturviprānbhojayetsnātakāndvijaḥ || 5 ||
items.en: He should practise japa, worship of the gods, homa and Vedic study. The twice-born should feed one, two, three or four brāhmaṇa snātakas.
items.note: snātaka: a man who has finished his Vedic studies and taken the ritual bath.

items.text:
स्वयंकृष्टे तथा क्षेत्रे धान्यैश्च स्वयमर्जितैः ।
निर्वपेत्पञ्च यज्ञांश्च क्रतुदीक्षां च कारयेत् ॥ ६ ॥
items.tr:
svayaṃkṛṣṭe tathā kṣetre dhānyaiśca svayamarjitaiḥ |
nirvapetpañca yajñāṃśca kratudīkṣāṃ ca kārayet || 6 ||
items.en: With grain he has earned himself from a field he has ploughed himself, he should perform the five daily sacrifices and also be consecrated for Vedic sacrifices.
items.note: five daily sacrifices (pañca yajña): daily offerings to the Veda, the ancestors, the gods, living beings and guests.

items.text:
तिला रसा न विक्रेया विक्रेया धान्यतत्समाः ।
विप्रस्यैवंविधा वृत्तिस्तृणकाष्ठादिविक्रयः ॥ ७ ॥
items.tr:
tilā rasā na vikreyā vikreyā dhānyatatsamāḥ |
viprasyaivaṃvidhā vṛttistṛṇakāṣṭhādivikrayaḥ || 7 ||
items.en: Sesame and liquids must not be sold; grain and similar things may be sold. This is the livelihood allowed to a brāhmaṇa, along with selling grass, wood and the like.

items.text:
ब्राह्मणश्चेत्कृषिं कुर्यात्तन्महादोषं आप्नुयात् ।
संवत्सरेण यत्पापं मत्स्यघाती समाप्नुयात् ॥ ८ ॥
items.tr:
brāhmaṇaścetkṛṣiṃ kuryāttanmahādoṣaṃ āpnuyāt |
saṃvatsareṇa yatpāpaṃ matsyaghātī samāpnuyāt || 8 ||
items.en: If a brāhmaṇa farms, he incurs a great fault. The sin a fisherman gets in a year,

items.text:
अयोमुखेन काष्ठेन तदेकाहेन लाङ्गली ।
पाशको मत्स्यघाती च व्याधः शाकुनिकस्तथा ॥ ९ ॥
items.tr:
ayomukhena kāṣṭhena tadekāhena lāṅgalī |
pāśako matsyaghātī ca vyādhaḥ śākunikastathā || 9 ||
items.en: … a ploughman gets in one day with the iron-tipped wooden plough. The trapper, the fisherman, the hunter, the bird-catcher,

items.text:
अदाता कर्षकश्चैव सर्वे ते समभागिनः ।
वृक्षं छित्त्वा महीं भित्त्वा हत्वा च कृमिकीटकान् ॥ १० ॥
items.tr:
adātā karṣakaścaiva sarve te samabhāginaḥ |
vṛkṣaṃ chittvā mahīṃ bhittvā hatvā ca kṛmikīṭakān || 10 ||
items.en: … and the farmer who does not give: all of them share equally (in sin). By cutting trees, breaking the earth and killing worms and insects,

items.text:
कर्षकः खलयज्ञेन सर्वपापैः प्रमुच्यते ।
यो न दद्याद्द्विजातिभ्यो राशिमूलं उपागतः ॥ ११ ॥
items.tr:
karṣakaḥ khalayajñena sarvapāpaiḥ pramucyate |
yo na dadyāddvijātibhyo rāśimūlaṃ upāgataḥ || 11 ||
items.en: … a farmer (sins, but) is freed from all sins by the threshing-floor sacrifice. But one who comes to the grain heap and gives nothing to the twice-born
items.note: threshing-floor sacrifice (khala-yajña): giving a share of the harvest at the threshing floor.

items.text:
स चौरः स च पापिष्ठो ब्रह्मघ्नं तं विनिर्दिशेत् ।
राज्ञे दत्त्वा तु षड्भागं देवानां चैकविंशकं ॥ १२ ॥
items.tr:
sa cauraḥ sa ca pāpiṣṭho brahmaghnaṃ taṃ vinirdiśet |
rājñe dattvā tu ṣaḍbhāgaṃ devānāṃ caikaviṃśakaṃ || 12 ||
items.en: … is a thief and the worst sinner; he should be called a brāhmaṇa-killer. Giving a sixth part to the king, a twenty-first part to the gods,

items.text:
विप्राणां त्रिंशकं भागं सर्वपापैः प्रमुच्यते ।
क्षत्रियोऽपि कृषिं कृत्वा देवान्विप्रांश्च पूजयेत् ॥ १३ ॥
items.tr:
viprāṇāṃ triṃśakaṃ bhāgaṃ sarvapāpaiḥ pramucyate |
kṣatriyo'pi kṛṣiṃ kṛtvā devānviprāṃśca pūjayet || 13 ||
items.en: … and a thirtieth part to brāhmaṇas, he is freed from all sins. A kṣatriya too, if he farms, should honour the gods and brāhmaṇas.

items.text:
वैश्यः शूद्रस्तथा कुर्यात्कृषिवाणिज्यशिल्पकम् ।
विकर्म कुर्वते शूद्रा द्विजशुश्रूषयोज्झिताः ॥ १४ ॥
items.tr:
vaiśyaḥ śūdrastathā kuryātkṛṣivāṇijyaśilpakam |
vikarma kurvate śūdrā dvijaśuśrūṣayojjhitāḥ || 14 ||
items.en: A vaiśya and a śūdra too may do farming, trade and crafts. Śūdras who give up service to the twice-born and do work not meant for them

items.text:
भवन्त्यल्पायुषस्ते वै निरयं यान्त्यसंशयम् ।
चतुर्णां अपि वर्णानां एष धर्मः सनातनः ॥ १५ ॥
items.tr:
bhavantyalpāyuṣaste vai nirayaṃ yāntyasaṃśayam |
caturṇāṃ api varṇānāṃ eṣa dharmaḥ sanātanaḥ || 15 ||
items.en: … become short-lived and surely go to hell. This is the eternal dharma for all four varṇas.
